subject: REWRITE statement
notes: "The rewrite file connector is the file connector referenced by file-name-1 or the file-name associated with record-name-1." BindRewrite resolves record-name-1 through ResolveRecordName(..., out var file) and binds the statement (BoundRewrite / BoundKeyedRewrite) to THAT FileModel; both emitters key the runtime call by FileKeyExpr(file). A GLOBAL FD's records reached from a contained program keep the owner's shared FileModel (BinderDriver GLOBAL FD inheritance), so the connector is the owner's. The file-name-1 arm is the declined A.4.13 FILE phrase (PB282). pb348_from_into_move_rules' RWFROM line derives that the REWRITE replaced F's last-read record. cite.py --check 14.9.35.4 GR2 -> OK.
